format: WSDC Registry Events, who decides heats and contest structure

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: The Raw Score Judge has no access to scores and does not determine heats, callbacks, cuts to finals or other contest-structure decisions; those duties belong to the Chief Judge or Secondary Chief Judge.

requirement: A WSDC-declared event fails closed for running-order changes (COMPRO_BODY_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE) until the owner decides whether the running order is a contest-structure decision reserved to the Chief Judge; if so, the designated Chief Judge (PR 834) must decide or approve and WSDC role separation stays intact.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation.
interpretation_notes: The definition names heats, callbacks, cuts to finals and 'any other contest structure decisions'. Whether the order in which contests run is covered is not stated (Q3). NOT IMPLEMENTED; profile blocker.
